preregistration_scope: Prospective follow-up informed by already observed v1 synthetic failures; not an independent preregistration of those prior results and not an astronomical completeness claim.
scientific_question: Can a matched-template transient search control per-curve false alarms across a prespecified noise-misspecification envelope while retaining useful 4-sigma recovery relative to a single-epoch baseline?
claim_boundary: Synthetic statistical qualification only. A passing result may justify a more robust shadow-search statistic for real-data evaluation; it cannot establish survey completeness, astrophysical classification, novelty, reportability, or live operational readiness.

candidate_statistics.definition: Current maximum positive profiled matched-template statistic; no new covariance is inferred from the evaluation curve. Threshold is calibrated against the full nuisance envelope rather than one null model.

For the template selected by the full curve, use min(full statistic, minimum leave-one-observation-out selected-template statistic with the constant background refit). This deliberately requires evidence not to depend on one observation.

Development-only candidate: robustly center standardized residuals, divide by max(1, 1.4826*MAD), clip to [-4,4], apply the same template bank, and combine with the same leave-one-observation-out minimum. The resulting value is an empirical search statistic, not a Gaussian z-score or chi-square.

candidate_selection_rule.feasibility: Reject a candidate if its maximum development false-alarm fraction across calibration-envelope null regimes exceeds 0.02 after a provisional worst-regime threshold is applied.
candidate_selection_rule.utility: Among feasible candidates, maximize macro-average 4-sigma recovery across template families and the prespecified signal-noise regimes.
candidate_selection_rule.simplicity_tie_break: If candidates differ by less than 0.01 absolute macro-average 4-sigma recovery, choose the simpler candidate in this order: raw_bank_envelope_calibrated, selected_template_leave_one_out_stability, huberized_stability.
candidate_selection_rule.lock: After selection, freeze the statistic implementation and digest before calibration and locked evaluation. No candidate switching after calibration or locked evaluation begins.

threshold_calibration_rule: For the frozen selected statistic, compute a threshold independently within each calibration-envelope null regime using only calibration data at the 99.5th percentile, then use the maximum of those regime thresholds as the single locked threshold. Do not use locked-evaluation or generalization-probe data to choose or alter the threshold.

primary_endpoints.safety: Maximum locked false-alarm fraction across the calibration-envelope null regimes.
primary_endpoints.utility: Macro-average paired 4-sigma recovery difference versus the single-epoch comparator across signal families, signal-noise regimes, and cadence realizations.

secondary_endpoints: recovery by signal family and width
false-alarm fraction on each locked generalization probe
distribution of false-alarm fractions across cadence realizations
recovery difference versus the current raw bank under matched IID noise
fraction of detections rejected by leave-one-observation-out stability

uncertainty.false_alarm_intervals: Two-sided 95% Wilson intervals with exact numerator and denominator for every null regime; do not pool regimes before reporting them.
uncertainty.recovery_comparisons: Paired bootstrap over cadence realizations, preserving the shared simulated signal/noise draw across methods; report point estimate and 95% interval.
uncertainty.multiple_comparisons: Primary endpoints are prespecified. Subgroup and generalization-probe analyses are secondary and must be labelled exploratory unless separately corrected.

promotion_gate.safety_point_estimate: For every calibration-envelope null regime, locked false-alarm fraction must be <= 0.01.
promotion_gate.safety_uncertainty: For every calibration-envelope null regime, the upper bound of the 95% Wilson interval must be <= 0.015.
promotion_gate.utility_minimum_useful_effect: Macro-average paired 4-sigma recovery improvement versus single epoch must be >= 0.05 absolute and its 95% paired-bootstrap lower bound must exceed 0.
promotion_gate.matched_noise_noninferiority: Under matched IID Gaussian noise, 4-sigma recovery may not be more than 0.10 absolute below the v1 raw bank.
promotion_gate.failure_rule: Failure of any safety gate blocks promotion of the statistic. Results remain publishable as a negative/null robustness result; do not retune against locked evaluation.

reproducibility.separation: Development, calibration, and locked evaluation use disjoint seeds and generated curves. Generalization probes are never used to select the statistic or threshold.
reproducibility.negative_results: All failed gates and adverse regimes must remain in the final artifact set and manuscript text.

amendment_policy: Any change to endpoints, nuisance regimes, candidate definitions, selection rule, threshold rule, sample sizes, or promotion gates after the first v2 development run requires a versioned amendment that states what was observed before the change. The original protocol remains immutable.
